context: A dad jokes around with his young son about hobbies
purpose: Teach: ケータイ/オタク/あらかじめ/あきらめ/ものすごく/ビックリ/とりわけ/ひたすら

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 翔、お前最近ケータイばっかり見てるけど、何にそんな夢中なんだ?
lines.en: Sho, you're always staring at your phone lately, what are you so into?
lines.style: Teasing fatherly tone, curious but warm voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 電車の動画!ものすごく面白いんだよ、パパも見て!
lines.en: Train videos! They're super interesting, Dad, you watch too!
lines.style: Excited child voice, eager to share his enthusiasm

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: おお、電車オタクか?パパもびっくりだよ、いつの間にそんなに詳しくなったんだ?
lines.en: Oh, a train geek? Dad's surprised, when did you get so knowledgeable?
lines.style: Playful teasing, mock amazement in his voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: とりわけ新幹線が好き!あらかじめ時刻表も全部覚えちゃったんだよ!
lines.en: Especially the bullet train! I memorized the whole timetable in advance!
lines.style: Proud child boasting, energetic and earnest delivery

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ビックリだな、パパの子供の頃と一緒だ。パパは野球ばっかりだったけどな。
lines.en: Wow, just like Dad when I was a kid. Though I was all about baseball.
lines.style: Nostalgic chuckle, warm reminiscing fatherly tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、野球の夢はもうあきらめちゃったの?
lines.en: Dad, did you already give up on your baseball dream?
lines.style: Innocent child question, slightly worried curious tone

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うっ、痛いとこ突くなあ。まあ、ひたすら練習したけど才能がなくてな。
lines.en: Ouch, that hits a sore spot. I practiced relentlessly but had no talent.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh, lighthearted dad humor in voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあ僕、パパの分まで電車の運転手になる!
lines.en: Then I'll become a train driver for Dad's sake too!
lines.style: Enthusiastic child declaration, determined and cute delivery
